| reject | Reject the event, field, or bundle when unsafe content cannot be safely removed. | false | false |  |

### Redaction validation

- Missing action: `reject`
- Ambiguous match action: `reject`
- Redaction failure action: `reject`
- Rejected content must be discarded: `true`

## Retention tiers

- Age unit: `seconds`
- Age values are configuration metadata: `true`
- Production legal retention commitment: `false`

| Name | Purpose | Durability | Compression | Delete policy | Default age | Maximum age | Age configurable | Legal commitment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| audit_grade | Audit-worthy aggregated records created by an explicit audit trigger. | durable | lossless_or_integrity_preserving | retain_until_configured_audit_age_expires_or_authorized_disposition | 0 | 0 | true | false |
| diagnostic_report | User- or tester-facing bug reports, copy diagnostics, and bounded diagnostic bundles. | durable_until_report_expiry | recommended | delete_when_configured_report_age_expires_or_report_is_expunged | 1209600 | 0 | true | false |
| ephemeral_dev | Local development and temporary subsystem debugging. | best_effort | optional | delete_on_shutdown_or_when_configured_age_expires | 0 | 0 | true | false |
| operational | Routine operational diagnosis and cross-service event investigation. | durable | recommended | delete_when_configured_age_expires_or_storage_pressure_requires_eviction | 0 | 0 | true | false |

## Diagnostic bundle

- Name: `diagnostic_bundle`
- Schema version: `1`
- Diagnostic report ID: `UUID`, required: `true`
- Safe to copy default: `true` (field `safe_to_copy`)

### Limits

| Limit | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Maximum events | `500` |
| Maximum event bytes | `65536` |
| Maximum total bytes | `5242880` |
| Maximum metadata fields | `32` |
| Maximum correlation fields | `16` |
| Maximum redaction summary entries | `32` |

### Sections

| Name | Required | Allowed fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| correlation | true | audit_event_id, diagnostic_report_id, match_id, request_id, room_id, session_id, trace_id |
| metadata | true | build_version, client_version, diagnostic_report_id, environment, generated_at, locale, platform, schema_version, server_version, service |
| redaction_summary | true | policy_version, redacted_event_count, redacted_field_count, redaction_applied, rejected_event_count, rejected_field_count, replacement_marker |

### Events

- Required: `true`
- Ordered by: `timestamp_ascending`
- Truncated when limit exceeded: `true`

| build_version | string | false |

| player_id | string | false |

| room_id | string | false |
| schema_version | integer | false |
| service | string | true |
| service_instance_id | uuid | false |
| session_id | string | false |
| timestamp | string | true |
| trace_id | uuid | false |

### Forbidden content

- Behavior: `redact_when_safe_otherwise_reject`
- Raw value preserved: `false`
- Rejected event included: `false`
- Rejected field included: `false`
- Replacement marker: `[REDACTED]`
- Redaction summary counts rejected content: `true`
- Redaction failure behavior: `reject_bundle`
- Unknown event field behavior: `reject_event`
